judge: Claude (an LLM, not a human), blind to which system produced each candidate; one-liner texts only; labels written before system identities were joined.
rule: 1 = a founder of the query startup would plausibly name the candidate as a competitor: same product category, selling to a similar customer or use case. 0 = shares words, a broad industry or an adjacent tool only. Vertical-specific products count only when the query is also that vertical; generic-category products count when the query is the vertical version of that category.
